name: Modern SEO - Module 1 Foundation and Diagnosis
body:
> Course · 2026-10-22

Part of: [Modern SEO Course](lib:brain-modern-seo-course) | [Learning Index](lib:brain-learning-index)

# Summary
Module 1 (5 lessons, about 25 minutes; Lesson 2 recorded in 4 parts) is the foundation. It shows a live diagnosis of a stuck business, explains the ranking model, lays out the agency roadmap, and details the three-step method. Core message: in local SEO you rank the [Google Business Profile](lib:brain-google-business-profile), you measure with a rank map, and you fix the basics before anything advanced.

# Lessons
- [Modern SEO - M1L1 Modern SEO Welcome](lib:brain-modern-seo-m1l1-modern-seo-welcome): course overview, promises process over theory, introduces Core 30 and super citations, and the 70 to 80% claim.
- [Modern SEO - M1L2 Live Website Breakdown](lib:brain-modern-seo-m1l2-live-website-breakdown): diagnosis of an HVAC company in Wichita (`site:` counts, rank map, GBP and homepage check), four half-hour fixes, then Core 30.
- [Modern SEO - M1L3 How Google and AI Actually Work](lib:brain-modern-seo-m1l3-how-google-and-ai-actually-work): proximity, relevance, trust; top 3 percentage as the core metric; "open book SEO"; ChatGPT and Bing claim.
- [Modern SEO - M1L4 How We Do Local SEO](lib:brain-modern-seo-m1l4-how-we-do-local-seo): the agency roadmap, rank map as North Star, green target, local links, Core 30, then geographic relevance.
- [Modern SEO - M1L5 The Low Competition Ranking Method](lib:brain-modern-seo-m1l5-the-low-competition-ranking-method): the three steps in detail (GBP audit, landing page audit, super citations).

# How the lessons connect
- Lesson 3 gives the model. Lesson 4 turns it into an ordered roadmap. Lesson 5 details the first phase.
- Lesson 2 applies the Lesson 5 checklist to a real business before the theory is taught.
- The primary category rule appears in Lessons 2 and 5: do not change it if it already ranks well.
- The rank map runs through everything.

# Combined framework
1. Measure: rank map for primary category + city, every other week, before any change.
2. Diagnose: keyword + city search, `site:` on top 3 and client, compare Top 3%.
3. GBP audit and fix: up to 10 categories, 20 to 30 services, primary category matched to searches.
4. Landing page audit and fix: schema, phone, address, GBP embed, title tag and H1.
5. Super citations on verification-required platforms.
6. Chamber of Commerce link.
7. Check the map; below target, 1 to 2 high-trust local links per month.
8. Core 30 if still below target.
9. Geographic relevance once the target is reached.
10. Ongoing: a decent link for every new page.

# Open questions
- Lesson 1's preview numbering does not match the files.
- Green target 20 to 40% (audio) vs 30 to 40% (slides).
- Claims to check: ChatGPT relies on Bing's index; LeadSnap can skip verification; 70 to 80% success rate.
